usage: 炸雞翼 is a noun used to refer specifically to fried chicken wings as a food item.
It can be used as a subject in sentences, for example, '炸雞翼 好味' (Fried chicken wings are tasty).
炸雞翼 can also be used as an object when talking about ordering or eating it, like '我想食炸雞翼' (I want to eat fried chicken wings).
You can use it with quantifiers to specify amounts, such as '兩隻炸雞翼' (two fried chicken wings).
It often appears on menus to list chicken wing dishes.
